description: Approved tags for integration_metadata.json. Tags are secondary facets — every distinct tag becomes a row in the marketplace Tags filter, so a tag only earns its place if more than one listing can carry it. Vendor names, product names, and one-off descriptors belong in `keywords` instead (searchable, not a facet). Unknown tags are a warning, not an error; propose additions in a PR for a CODEOWNER to approve.
